name: Godou Gen'ichirou
source:
The proprietor of CADENZA.
Despite having to bite the bullet and give Sousuke the boot when he became a fugitive, Genichirou's true nature remains caring. Typically a man of few words, he cherishes the moments spent in lively conversation with his close friends.
